name: Ellis Angel
source:
A priestess warrior dispatched by the kingdom. She was the best of the best, but retired after falling in love with a aristocrat. 

However, she needs funding in order to receive a blessing for a child, so she rejoined the arena as a fighter. She has the appeal of a motherly and kindly woman.
